scope: Actual built WebGL under desktop Chromium and mobile-detection model; deterministic local account fixtures only.

victorySave.note: Unity JsonUtility may emit an empty combat object for null. Stage=Campfire is the active-state discriminator.

limitations: Physical mobile touch hardware was not tested. Drag simulation did not establish real touch input.

The optional local mobile-detection harness produced a ResizeObserver notification-loop alert at startup; normal retry/dismiss allowed the actual game to run. Desktop fixtures had no runtime console errors.
